[2026-08-18T23:51:30.955Z] [world] Of the Tartarian Giants, sworn to the Mud Monarchs: you have crossed into Tartaria. The buried country. The cataclysm that made it was called the Aetherstone Flood, and it ended a thousand years ago — yet here, at ground level, it never quite stopped. The mud still moves. The air still hums.
[2026-08-18T23:51:30.955Z] [world] Monarch Court rises out of the silt at the edge of The Monarch's Waystation. You arrive at The Atrium. Polished mud-glass tiles and a carved Monarch sigil over the doorway. The seneschal nods you through without speaking — your business has already been logged elsewhere.
[2026-08-18T23:51:30.956Z] [world] The Arbiter is already here, slouched against a post under a cloak that has seen more weather than most people. He looks asleep. He isn't. His eyes track you for one quiet beat before he goes back to looking at nothing. An ash storm presses on the world — -1 STR. What you do here is yours to choose.
[2026-08-18T23:51:30.956Z] [world] Paths: north to Court · south to Landing 1. (Type 'leave outpost' to head into the wilds.)
